title: Tokenization: text becomes an indexed sequence
objectives: Implement the worked example and validate its boundary conditions
Use the diagnostic evidence to explain a release decision
relevance: In the fictional CI quality platform, this skill connects tokenization: text becomes an indexed sequence with test contracts, failure triage, and evidence for release. Create a token budget report for ten CI logs: model/tokenizer revision, input count, reserved output count and retained evidence.

sections.title: Problem and intuition
paragraphs: A transformer consumes integer token IDs, not words. Subword tokenizers split unfamiliar identifiers into known fragments, so checkout_timeout can require several positions while a common word may require one. Whitespace, punctuation and Unicode normalization change the sequence. Vocabulary size is the number of IDs the model recognizes; sequence length is the number of positions in one input. Neither is the number of documents.

For failure triage, preserving exception names and paths can matter more than lowercasing everything. Compare raw and normalized logs with the actual model tokenizer before choosing preprocessing. Tokens have no universal meaning across models: ID 42 in one vocabulary is unrelated to ID 42 in another.

sections.title: Implement the mechanism
paragraphs: The local transformer lab uses a small, declared vocabulary so you can inspect every ID without downloading weights. Production experiments use AutoTokenizer from the model's published checkpoint, preserving attention masks and tokenizer revision alongside weights. Unknown IDs must map to an explicit unknown token rather than silently disappear.

Count prompt, retrieved context and requested completion together before making a request. Truncate on semantic boundaries and preserve the error cause; chopping the tail of a stack trace can remove the most useful evidence.

sections.title: Break it and diagnose it
paragraphs: A developer estimates cost from len(text.split()) and undercounts long stack traces. Reproduce with URLs, emoji and minified JSON, compare actual token counts, and inspect which evidence was removed. A tokenizer mismatch can also produce valid-looking IDs that feed the wrong embedding rows.
Test encode/decode round trips subject to documented normalization, empty strings, unknown characters, and context overflow. Do not assert that every word is exactly one token.

sections.title: Evaluate and apply
paragraphs: Create a token budget report for ten CI logs: model/tokenizer revision, input count, reserved output count and retained evidence. Reject inputs that exceed the budget before provider work. Record both truncation rate and downstream classification accuracy.
A shorter prompt is successful only if it preserves the decision-critical evidence. Compare the same held-out failures with and without normalization, keeping model and prompt versions fixed.

mistake: A developer estimates cost from len(text.split()) and undercounts long stack traces. Reproduce with URLs, emoji and minified JSON, compare actual token counts, and inspect which evidence was removed. A tokenizer mismatch can also produce valid-looking IDs that feed the wrong embedding rows.
takeaway: Create a token budget report for ten CI logs: model/tokenizer revision, input count, reserved output count and retained evidence.

title: Attention: query, key and value with a causal mask
objectives: Implement the worked example and validate its boundary conditions
Use the diagnostic evidence to explain a release decision
relevance: In the fictional CI quality platform, this skill connects attention: query, key and value with a causal mask with test contracts, failure triage, and evidence for release. Use the attention calculator to vary scores and observe normalized weights and the value mixture.

sections.title: Problem and intuition
paragraphs: Attention asks which other positions should contribute to the current position. A query represents what a position seeks; keys describe what each position offers; values contain the information to aggregate. Compute query-key dot products, scale by the square root of key dimension, apply the permitted-position mask, then softmax each query row.

The output is a weighted sum of values, not the selected key or a database lookup. In a failure log, the word timeout may attend to database rather than unrelated login text. Learned projections determine this behavior; a diagram illustrates a mechanism, not a proof that a model understands a cause.

sections.title: Implement the mechanism
paragraphs: For one query q=[1,0], keys [[1,0],[0,1]] and values [[4,0],[0,2]], unscaled scores are [1,0]. Softmax gives approximately [0.731,0.269], so the output is [2.924,0.538]. Scaling changes the weights. Subtract the maximum score before exponentiating for numerical stability.

Decoder self-attention masks future positions with negative infinity before softmax. Padding masks prevent empty slots from absorbing weight. Each head has its own projections; concatenated heads pass through an output projection, allowing different relationships without assuming each head has a fixed human label.
sections.code:
import math
def softmax(scores):
    m=max(scores)
    e=[math.exp(s-m) for s in scores]
    return [v/sum(e) for v in e]
print(softmax([1,0]))

sections.title: Break it and diagnose it
paragraphs: A mask applied after softmax without renormalizing leaves a row sum below one. A transposed key matrix or wrong softmax axis mixes batch examples instead of positions. Test shape contracts, finite weights, nonnegative weights and row sums of one.
A decoder trained with visible future tokens can show excellent training loss and fail during generation. Check that perturbing a future token cannot change earlier outputs in evaluation mode.

sections.title: Evaluate and apply
paragraphs: Use the attention calculator to vary scores and observe normalized weights and the value mixture. Implement stable softmax and test extreme scores such as [1000,1001]. The stability test is an SDET boundary check with a mathematical invariant.

Attention weights help inspect the computation but are not sufficient explanations of factual correctness. Validate final claims against source evidence and test causal masking independently of answer quality.

mistake: A mask applied after softmax without renormalizing leaves a row sum below one. A transposed key matrix or wrong softmax axis mixes batch examples instead of positions. Test shape contracts, finite weights, nonnegative weights and row sums of one.
takeaway: Use the attention calculator to vary scores and observe normalized weights and the value mixture.

exercise.prompt: Implement softmax(scores), stable for very large scores. Return [] for no scores.
exercise.solution:
import math
def softmax(scores):
    if not scores: return []
    e=[math.exp(s-max(scores)) for s in scores]
    return [v/sum(e) for v in e]
exercise.tests:
assert softmax([])==[]
assert abs(sum(softmax([1000,1001]))-1)<1e-9
assert softmax([1,1])==[0.5,0.5]

title: Transformer blocks: position, residuals and encoder–decoder roles
objectives: Implement the worked example and validate its boundary conditions
Use the diagnostic evidence to explain a release decision
relevance: In the fictional CI quality platform, this skill connects transformer blocks: position, residuals and encoder–decoder roles with test contracts, failure triage, and evidence for release. Sketch the failure-classification encoder path and the support-answer decoder path with input/output shapes.

sections.title: Problem and intuition
paragraphs: Attention alone is permutation equivariant: swapping input positions swaps outputs without expressing order. Positional information supplies order through learned embeddings, sinusoidal encodings or rotary mechanisms. A transformer block combines attention with a position-wise feed-forward network, residual connections and normalization. Residual paths let gradients flow without replacing the entire representation at every layer.

An encoder can see both directions and produce representations for classification or retrieval. A causal decoder predicts the next token from preceding tokens. An encoder-decoder model reads a source sequence and generates a target with cross-attention to encoded source positions.

sections.title: Implement the mechanism
paragraphs: Track shapes before code: token IDs [batch,length], hidden vectors [batch,length,width], per-head Q/K/V [batch,heads,length,head_width]. Project width into head dimensions, form scores [batch,heads,length,length], then return to hidden width. Feed-forward layers expand and contract each position's width.

The runnable lab uses torch.nn.TransformerEncoderLayer and an explicit padding mask. Inspect train/eval behavior because dropout changes repeated outputs. Persist vocabulary, positional convention and maximum length with the checkpoint.
sections.code:
import torch
from torch import nn
layer=nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(d_model=16,nhead=4,batch_first=True)
layer.eval()
x=torch.zeros(2,5,16)
with torch.no_grad():
    assert layer(x).shape == (2,5,16)

sections.title: Break it and diagnose it
paragraphs: Confusing an embedding encoder with a generation decoder produces an integration mismatch: sentence vectors are not next-token distributions. Forgetting positional information can make two differently ordered log messages nearly indistinguishable.

A successful tensor shape does not prove a correct mask. Test padding invariance and causal invariance, then compare held-out quality. Length-dependent failures often indicate truncation or positional limits rather than random provider errors.

sections.title: Evaluate and apply
paragraphs: Sketch the failure-classification encoder path and the support-answer decoder path with input/output shapes. Explain why cross-attention is appropriate for source-to-target generation and why sentence embeddings need a pooling strategy.

For an SDET, architecture knowledge enables focused tests: permutation sensitivity, padding invariance, finite outputs, and reproducible evaluation mode. These contracts complement task-level precision and evidence correctness.

mistake: Confusing an embedding encoder with a generation decoder produces an integration mismatch: sentence vectors are not next-token distributions. Forgetting positional information can make two differently ordered log messages nearly indistinguishable.
takeaway: Sketch the failure-classification encoder path and the support-answer decoder path with input/output shapes.

exercise.solution: Padding changes should leave real-token outputs unchanged under the mask. Changing future tokens must leave earlier decoder outputs unchanged. Use eval mode to disable dropout before comparing.

title: Next-token training: shifted targets and cross-entropy
objectives: Implement the worked example and validate its boundary conditions
Use the diagnostic evidence to explain a release decision
relevance: In the fictional CI quality platform, this skill connects next-token training: shifted targets and cross-entropy with test contracts, failure triage, and evidence for release. A decreasing loss proves optimization progress under the training objective, not better grounded answers.

sections.title: Problem and intuition
paragraphs: A causal language model learns to predict the next token from the preceding sequence. Training pairs logits at position t with the observed token at t+1. Cross-entropy penalizes assigning low probability to the observed target. This objective teaches statistical continuation, not factual verification or authorization.

Pretraining supplies broad text patterns; instruction tuning changes task-following examples; preference/reward methods influence which responses are favored. These stages differ in data and objective, and none removes the need for evidence-grounded application checks.

sections.title: Implement the mechanism
paragraphs: For a target token assigned probability .25, the negative log-likelihood is −log(.25), about 1.386 nats. Average over valid target positions, excluding padded or intentionally masked labels. In a causal model, the library may perform the shift internally; inspect the model contract before shifting twice.

The local PyTorch mechanisms lab demonstrates logits, loss and gradients, while the genuine PEFT example adapts a pretrained encoder for the five-class task. Keep classification fine-tuning distinct from causal language-model supervised tuning.
sections.code:
import math
probability_of_target=.25
loss=-math.log(probability_of_target)
assert abs(loss-1.38629436112)<1e-9

sections.title: Break it and diagnose it
paragraphs: A developer aligns each position with itself, allowing input-token copying rather than next-token prediction. Another applies softmax before a cross-entropy function expecting logits. Padding contributes loss and dominates short examples.
Test shifted alignment, masked positions, finite loss and gradient flow. Use a hand-computed two-token probability example as an independent loss oracle.

sections.title: Evaluate and apply
paragraphs: A decreasing loss proves optimization progress under the training objective, not better grounded answers. Evaluate the downstream task and safety contract on independent examples after any adaptation.

SDETs should retain objective, target alignment and masking configuration in training artifacts. Understanding the objective explains why fluent continuation can coexist with hallucinated claims and why the application still needs retrieval, uncertainty and evaluation.

mistake: A developer aligns each position with itself, allowing input-token copying rather than next-token prediction. Another applies softmax before a cross-entropy function expecting logits. Padding contributes loss and dominates short examples.
takeaway: A decreasing loss proves optimization progress under the training objective, not better grounded answers.

title: Position information and causal invariance tests
objectives: Position information and causal invariance tests
Implement the worked example and validate its boundary conditions
Use the diagnostic evidence to explain a release decision
relevance: In the fictional CI quality platform, this skill connects position information and causal invariance tests with test contracts, failure triage, and evidence for release. Keep positional configuration and tokenizer revision with model artifacts.

sections.title: Problem and intuition
paragraphs: A sequence model must distinguish database failed after login from login failed after database. Token embeddings identify symbols, while positional mechanisms encode their order. Sinusoidal encodings use different frequencies by dimension; learned positional embeddings use a trained table; rotary embeddings transform queries and keys to express relative position relationships.
These mechanisms have different extrapolation behavior and configuration. A larger advertised context window is not achieved by simply appending zeros to the positional table.

sections.title: Implement the mechanism
paragraphs: For a simple sinusoidal demonstration, encode even coordinates with sin(pos/10000^(2i/d)) and odd coordinates with cos of the same angle. Add the position vector to the token representation in the classic formulation. Rotary mechanisms instead rotate paired coordinates in attention projections.

To test a causal decoder, compare early-position outputs before and after changing a later token in eval mode. Their equality within numerical tolerance verifies the mask's information-flow contract. Padding tests similarly perturb only masked positions.
sections.code:
import math
def position(pos):
    return [math.sin(pos),math.cos(pos),math.sin(pos/100),math.cos(pos/100)]
assert position(0)==[0.,1.,0.,1.]

sections.title: Break it and diagnose it
paragraphs: A decoder's triangular mask is inverted, exposing future tokens. The test uses dropout in training mode and incorrectly attributes random differences to the mask. An index off-by-one assigns the same position to two adjacent tokens.
Control random state and evaluation mode, inspect the permitted-position matrix and test sequences of several lengths including one. Shape tests alone do not detect future-information leakage.

sections.title: Evaluate and apply
paragraphs: Keep positional configuration and tokenizer revision with model artifacts. Report how truncation and longer sequences affect task quality rather than assuming every allowed position is equally useful.

An SDET can test position mechanisms with invariants: different positions have different encodings in the valid range, output dimensions are stable and future perturbations cannot influence earlier causal outputs. These checks isolate architecture behavior from semantic answer evaluation.

mistake: A decoder's triangular mask is inverted, exposing future tokens. The test uses dropout in training mode and incorrectly attributes random differences to the mask. An index off-by-one assigns the same position to two adjacent tokens.
takeaway: Keep positional configuration and tokenizer revision with model artifacts.
